Second public test build. Video and voice messages work much better, messages look closer to Telegram
Desktop, and you can copy text out of chats.

**Updating from 0.1.0-alpha.2:** that version only offers this update when **Settings > Advanced >
Install beta versions** is on. Turn it on, or install this release from the files below. From this
release on, test builds update to the next test build by themselves.

## Highlights

- **Videos play with sound in sync.** Video sound goes through Rustgram's audio output and stays in
  sync with the picture, also after you seek.
- **Voice messages are sent.** A voice message you record is now sent to the chat.
- **Copy text from messages.** Select text in a message and copy it with Ctrl+C or from the context
  menu.
- **Reactions look like Telegram Desktop.** Custom emoji and paid reactions are drawn as Telegram
  Desktop draws them, and reactions on older messages update when they change.
- **Spoilers like Telegram Desktop.** Hidden text uses Telegram Desktop's spoiler cover, fades in when
  you reveal it, and stays revealed in that chat.
- **Telegram Desktop's emoji everywhere.** Emoji in messages, the chat list, names and the input field
  use the same images as Telegram Desktop, and flags show as flags.
- **Coloured sender names.** Names in group chats use each person's profile colour, with the
  matching palette in night mode.
- **Deleting a message** plays Telegram Desktop's dust effect, and the gap closes smoothly.

Plus 16 more fixes and improvements.

<details>
<summary>All changes</summary>

### New

- Video sound plays through the app's audio output and stays in sync with the picture.
- Recorded voice messages are sent.
- Copy selected message text with Ctrl+C or the context menu.
- Emoji use Telegram Desktop's emoji images, also inside message text, previews, names and the input field.
- Deleted messages turn to dust like in Telegram Desktop.
- `rustgram --version` and `rustgram --help` print and exit, and an unknown command-line option is
  refused, instead of starting the app.
- Release files come with build provenance attestations, and published releases get VirusTotal scan
  links.

### Fixed

- Custom emoji and paid reactions are drawn as Telegram Desktop's reaction buttons.
- Reactions on older messages update when they change.
- Spoilers: Telegram Desktop's cover, a fade when revealed, and the revealed state is remembered per
  chat.
- Sender names use the colour from their profile, with the night-mode name palette.
- Text is drawn with the same weight as in Telegram Desktop.
- After seeking a video, the picture waits for the new frames instead of jumping; short videos in chats
  play at the right frame times.
- Collapsed stories sit in the chat list's search field; the expanded stories strip sits under it.
- A sent message flies from the input field into its own bubble.
- The highlight of selected messages starts below the date badge.
- Quotes take exactly the space they are drawn in.
- Demo mode: chat photos and album tiles load their full pictures.
- Test builds compare their full version number, so an alpha now updates to the next alpha.
- Video playback no longer freezes the window while a part of the video is still downloading.
- The installer no longer registers Rustgram for tg:// links unless you tick that option.

### Under the hood

- Updated the bundled SQLite and zip libraries and replaced an unmaintained date library.
- Every release is started on a copy of a profile from 0.1.0-alpha.2 before it is published, to make
  sure your existing data still opens.
- The updater refuses an update file whose version does not match the release it came from.

</details>

## Install or update

- **Installer:** `Rustgram-Setup-0.2.0-alpha.1-win-x64.exe`.
- **Portable:** unzip `rustgram-0.2.0-alpha.1-win-x64-portable.zip` and run `rustgram.exe`.
- This is a pre-release: installed copies get it on the beta channel only (see above).
- Check a download: `gh attestation verify <file> -R murmaider227/rustgram`, or compare it with
  `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
